decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module still has its own page in both years and costs little to carry as a modular add-on, so it remains a cheap option worth holding while the firm's portfolio shifts and other launches have been withdrawn.

The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation at Kolumbus combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, and it is still mentioned in 2024, so its modest carrying cost and the positive evidence favor keeping the option open, though its lower visibility leaves some risk of quiet removal.
